title: Beta cohort approval flow + edge probe notes
content:
Purpose
- Quick personal notebook for the small beta (edge probe) we want to run for v2.3. Focused on authorization flow, client whitelisting, and safe-seeding of traffic to limited clients. Not a final runbook — more like my run-through before I demo this to PM/CS.

High-level summary (one-liner)
- Soft-launch beta to 150 active users across NA+EU, routed to model variant "mri-v2.3-beta" with strict feature-flag gating and an emergency kill switch in the gateway. Ramp to 3% traffic from whitelisted clients over 72h, then evaluate metrics before broader rollout.

Approval flow (who signs off + quick checklist)
- Engineering owner (me) -> SRE review (latency/observability) -> Product PM (impact) -> Privacy/Legal (data retention + KMS) -> CS (selected customers notified).
- Checklist for sign-off (short):
  - SRE: tracing + p95 baseline, canary dashboards configured
  - Product: evaluation prompt set + user-impact statement
  - Privacy: confirm telemetry retention window and PII filters enabled
  - CS: customer comms template ready + opt-out flow defined

Cohort selection rules (how to pick the 150)
- Start with 3 customer segments: internal beta users (50), partner integrators (50), and opt-in self-serve signups (50).
- Geo split: 60% NA / 30% EU / 10% APAC (APAC only if regional infra available; otherwise skip).
- SDK constraint: only clients on SDK >= 1.9.2 allowed (we need KV cache handshake that v1.9.2 includes).
- Client whitelisting: use feature-flag service with list of client IDs; do not rely on client-side opt-in alone.

Traffic ramp plan (practical timeline)
- T0 (00:00): enable feature flag for internal beta cohort + enable debug logs (sampling 5%).
- T+6h: route 0.5% of whitelisted client traffic to mri-v2.3-beta (observability smoke)
- T+24h: 1% (validate p95, error rate, model quality quick-check)
- T+48h: 2% with expanded QA prompts run against live traffic copies
- T+72h: 3% and decision gate (if green, open to partner integrators; otherwise rollback)
- Ramp stops if any threshold breached (see rollback triggers).

Metrics to watch (primary / secondary)
- Primary (real-time alerts configured):
  - Server error rate (5xx) for mri-v2.3-beta > 0.5% over 10m -> alert
  - Latency p95 increase vs baseline > 40% sustained for 15m -> alert
  - Model quality regression (eval set delta) > 3% absolute drop -> alert
- Secondary: token-cost per request, client-side SDK errors, tail latency p99.
- Observability: turn on per-client traces and enable prefix cache hit-rate metric.

Rollback triggers (automated + manual guidelines)
- Automated immediate rollback if:
  - 5xx rate for cohort > 1% for 5m OR
  - p95 latency > 2x baseline for 5m OR
  - Eval set automated sentinel prompts start failing (threshold above)
- Manual rollback recommended if:
  - Product reports > 10 customer-impact incidents in support queue within 12h
  - Privacy/legal flags an unexpected telemetry capture
- Rollback plan: switch feature-flag to stable model variant, drain beta pool, run diagnostics, open incident bridge.

Edge probe specifics (what to test at edge)
- Geo routing edge-cases: validate latency SLO from EU region; ensure fallback to nearest replica works.
- CDN/edge TTL: ensure no caching of personalized completions. Add header to responses: Cache-Control: no-store.
- SDK handshake: verify KV cache warm-up across restarts — watch & expose cache rehydration metric.
- Private deployment note: for any customer on Private, verify KMS key alias mapping before enabling beta (PRIV-keys may differ, risk: token encryption mismatch).

Model pinning & variant mapping (how we name things)
- Stable tag: mri-v2.3
- Beta tag: mri-v2.3-beta
- Fallback: mri-v2.2-stable (auto-fallback policy in router for error budget breaches)
- Always include model_version header in logs: X-Model-Version: mri-v2.3-beta

Preflight checks (quick run-before-enable)
- infra: autoscaler rules present and max scale set to expected QPS * 2
- observability: dashboards created + alerting rules deployed to PagerDuty
- load: run short synthetic replay from EU + NA to validate 95/50/5 latency buckets
- QA: run head-to-head eval of 500 sentinel prompts and validate outputs parity thresholds

Customer comms & CS playbook (short)
- Template: one-email to participating partners with timeframe, what to expect, how to opt-out (link + support ticket).
- CS triage: tag incoming issues with label beta-cohort-2. Give CS a quick troubleshooting script: collect request id, model_version header, client SDK version.

Running notes / oddities observed (personal notes)
- Observed: small subset of partner calls were using old SDK (1.8.x) even after requesting upgrade — need forced block for beta.
- Thought: consider an SDK-side warning (non-blocking) plus server-side reject for mismatched SDK versions. Avoid surprising customers.
- Note to self: remind infra to not rotate KMS keys during first week. If rotation is planned, coordinate.

Open questions (to resolve before 72h gate)
- Should we include a soft cap on per-customer throughput to prevent one partner from dominating the 3%? (Yes, probably 20% of cohort traffic per customer.)
- Do we want telemetry anonymization on by default for this beta? Legal says yes for partner integrators; product wants raw inputs for debugging. Need a compromise: allow raw input capture only for flagged request-ids with explicit opt-in and short retention (7 days).
- Can we get a quick UX blurb for customers that will see model_version in response headers? Who owns that?

TODOs (actionable)
- [ ] Create feature-flag list and pre-seed with client IDs (FF: beta_cohort_v2_3) — assigned to Liam. (due 2026-02-20)
- [ ] Draft partner email and opt-out flow — assigned to Maya. (due 2026-02-21)
- [ ] Deploy per-cohort dashboards and add p95/p99 lines — assigned to SRE. (due 2026-02-22)
- [ ] Update SDK server handshake enforcement PR — assigned to Samir. (PR INF-4532)
- [ ] Run synthetic replay from EU region and attach results to INF-4789 incident card — assigned to me. (due before T0)

Quick history/log (for trace)
- 2026-01-18: first draft of plan (this doc)
- 2026-02-01: SRE smoke results (notes in linked PR)
- 2026-03-03: met with Legal, waiting on anonymization confirmation

Notes to self (closing)
- Keep the first 24h small and noisy instrumentation-heavy. If anything weird — kill fast and iterate.
- Pretend we are being watched by the customer success team and the security folks; be overly explicit in logs.

-- Asha
